index19.quantity: Cultural Victory progress, with component identities/limits owned by friendly-village-rewards.metricDefinitions.culturalProgress. At 0x82CF3644, load signed converted-city credits from 0x830ED41C + selector*4 and clamp to 0 through 999. At 0x82CF3688 and 0x82CF368C, load the admitted owned-Wonder count and native Great People count from 0x830ECBE4 + selector*4 and 0x830ED3F8 + selector*4.
index19.threshold: Sign-extend halfword 0x830E8FE6. The sum of the two words and clamped quantity must be at least five times (4 minus that halfword); otherwise return zero at 0x82CF3628.
index19.finalState: Sign-extend halfword 0x830E8FE4. If it is nonzero, return one only when it equals 4. If zero, return one when unsigned halfword 0x830E8FF2 differs from 4, otherwise zero.
index19.qualification: These are 32-bit guest arithmetic and branch conditions, not observed victory behavior. This eligibility threshold expands to 20 minus five times the halfword; the named UI's separate remaining-value arithmetic uses 19. Do not equate the two or infer a presentation defect from this packet.

index20.finalState: Sign-extend halfword 0x830E8FE4. If it is nonzero, return one only when it equals 3. If zero, return one when unsigned halfword 0x830E8FF2 differs from 3, otherwise zero.
